# Antigravity.codes

> > Antigravity is an AI-powered development platform and IDE featuring autonomous agents, MCP integration, and the Nano Banana AI image generation system.

Antigravity.codes serves as the official documentation and resource hub for Google Antigravity IDE, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux. The site also hosts an extensive gallery of 874+ Nano Banana AI image prompts across portrait, fashion, product photography, and branding categories.

## Key Topics

- Antigravity IDE
- Nano Banana Pro
- Gemini Nano Banana 3.0
- AI Agents
- Agent-First Development
- Autonomous Development
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- AI Image Generation
- Photorealistic Prompts
- Fashion Photography
- Product Photography
- Node.js
- Installation & Setup
- Development Platform
- ChatGPT Integration
